notablePrerequisites:
You have max speed.
Rex does not have summoning sickness.
Endrider Catalyzer and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
description:
Activate Rex using Endrider Catalyzer's ability by tapping it, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
